mcp_tools.name: semantic_code_taint_analysis_report
mcp_tools.title: Semantic code taint analysis report
mcp_tools.description: Submit a declared code graph (sources, sinks, sanitizers, transforms and directed data-flow edges); get a deterministic taint analysis — every source→sink pair classified tainted (shortest unsanitized path reported), sanitized, or unreachable, with a fixed severity table on sink kind — with verdict TAINTED / CLEAN / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Analyses the declared graph only; code is never parsed or fetched.

inputSchema.description: The taint-analysis manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the graph schema).

graph.description: The declared code graph: {nodes: [{id, role, kind}], edges: [{from, to}]} — role ∈ source|sink|sanitizer|transform (default transform).

expect.notes: Valid tainted path from source to exec sink. computed_spot_checks: path_length=1, severity=critical, verdict=TAINTED
